description: This file contains React components and hooks for authentication views in the Notesnook project, including login, signup, MFA, session expiry, and account recovery screens.

classes.name: AuthForm
classes.description: Reusable form component for authentication-related forms, handling submission, validation, and error display.

methods.name: getRouteComponent
methods.description: Returns the React component corresponding to a given authentication route.

methods.name: _openURL
methods.description: Internal function to navigate to a URL, setting configuration and handling redirect logic.

methods.name: maskEmail
methods.description: Obfuscates an email address for privacy display.

methods.name: isSessionExpired
methods.description: Checks if the user session has expired based on configuration.
